essays.text: 英譯中：請將下列英文句子譯成中文。（15 分）If education is the transmission of civilization, we are unquestionablyprogressing. Civilization is not inherited; it has to be learned and earned byeach generation anew. If the transmission should be interrupted for onecentury, civilization would die, and we should be savages again. So ourfinest contemporary achievement is our unprecedented expenditure of wealthand toil in the provision of higher education for all.
